mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Pillar of Ice</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is being pushed by Trundle's Pillar of Ice.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Trundle creates an icy pillar for @PillarDuration@ seconds, briefly <status>Knocking Back</status> enemies directly over it and <status>Slowing</status> nearby enemies by @SlowAmount@%.

mLocKeys.keySummary: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: When an enemy dies near Trundle, he restores <healing>@RegenPercent@ of its max Health</healing>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Subjugate</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Health is being drained by Trundle.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalPercentHPDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and stealing <scaleArmor>@ArmorMRShred*100@% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> over @ActualDurationOfDrainBuff@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Half of the damage and shred happen immediately and the other half happens over the duration.
The shred lasts for @DurationOfDrainForTooltip@ seconds after the drain ends.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Subjugate</titleLeft><mainText>Trundle is sapping Health, Armor and Magic Resist from an enemy.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Subjugate</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Armor and Magic Resist are being drained by Trundle.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Chomp</titleLeft><mainText>Trundle's next attack will deal bonus damage and drain Attack Damage from his target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Trundle's next Attack deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and briefly <status>Slows</status> by @SlowAmount*100@%, then Trundle gains <physicalDamage>@BonusAD@ Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for @SapDebuffDuration@ seconds and the enemy loses <physicalDamage>@SappedAD*-1@ Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for the same duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
{{ buff_desc_SpellEffects }}
Trundle gains @BonusRange@ attack range for this attack.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Frozen Domain</titleLeft><mainText>Trundle's Move Speed, Attack Speed are increased and he has increased healing from all sources.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Trundle freezes an area for @Duration@ seconds. While inside he gains <speed>@MSBonus*100@% Move Speed</speed>, <attackSpeed>@ASBonus*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, and @HealingBonus*100@% increased healing.
